# Forno 88

Wood-fired Neapolitan pizza at 88 Via Del Forno (Mercer & Spring), New York, NY 10012. Phone (212) 555-0188.

Menu: Margherita D.O.P. $19, Diavola 88 $23, Tartufo & Funghi $25.
Hours: Mon-Thu 12-10, Fri-Sat 12-11:30, Sun 1-9:30.
Pickup orders are ready in about 15 minutes; pay at the counter.
